scripts.text:
[Esseray]
A legend in the Novice world has disappeared to do something in Comodo.
You should find him.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
初心者世界的一位传奇人物去了克魔岛办事，之后就失踪了。
你去找找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
He can guide you along
the correct path...
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
他能为你指引正确的道路...

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Oh? Are you one of our Novice Society?
You're looking good.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
哦？你是初心者协会的成员吗？
看起来精神不错嘛。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
You look full of energy...
You seem strong enough to endure the test.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
你看起来精力充沛...
应该有实力通过考验。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
I know a way to become stronger. Are you willing you try it?
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
我知道一种变强的方法。你愿意试试吗？

scripts.text: No, I'm okay now.
scripts.translation: 不用了，我现在这样就好

scripts.text: I want to be stronger!
scripts.translation: 我想变得更强！

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
If you are satisfied with mediocrity, I can't help you.
Live a normal life then.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
如果你甘于平庸，我也帮不了你。
那就过普通人的生活吧。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Good!
A legend in the Novice world has disappeared to do something in Comodo.
You should find him.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
很好！
初心者世界的一位传奇人物去了克魔岛办事，之后就失踪了。
你去找找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
He can guide you along
the correct path...
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
他能为你指引正确的道路...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Sh --------- !!
Be quiet please.
You'll scare the fish.
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
嘘——！！
请安静点。
会把鱼吓跑的。

scripts.text: Hmm... 'scuse me...
scripts.translation: 嗯...抱歉，打扰了...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Aaaaaaak!!
What are you doing?
I told you be quiet!
They're swimmin' away bacause of the noise~
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
啊啊啊！！
你在干什么？
我不是叫你安静点吗！
吵死了，鱼都游走了~

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
(-- sh--aking --)
Who... are you?
Why are you disrupting my fishing?
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
（浑身发抖）
你...是谁？
为什么要打扰我钓鱼？

scripts.text: I have a delivery from Esseray...
scripts.translation: 我替艾瑟雷送东西来...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
What? Esseray? Esseray?
Hmm! I know him...
Esseray... Esseray... hmm.
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
什么？艾瑟雷？艾瑟雷？
嗯！我认识他...
艾瑟雷...艾瑟雷...嗯。

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Ahhhh --- !! ----- Ahhhh ---!!
Got it! --- Got it!
^0000FFA member of Novice Society in Aldebaran.^000000
Esseray, right? Wrong?
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
啊——！！——啊——！！
想起来了！想起来了！
^0000FF是艾尔帕兰初心者协会的成员。^000000
艾瑟雷，对吧？没错吧？

scripts.text: No he isn't
scripts.translation: 不是他

scripts.text: Yes, right
scripts.translation: 没错

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Hu hu~ my sense is still alive...
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
呼呼~我的直觉还挺灵的...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
So what do you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
那么，你找我有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
What?! He isn't?
Then where is Esseray from?
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
什么？！不是他？
那艾瑟雷是从哪里来的？

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
What -------- !!
That isn't important, right?
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
什——么！！
这不重要，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Then -------- !!
Why did you come here?
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
那——么！！
你为什么来这里？

scripts.text: - You explain why you're here. -
scripts.translation: - 你解释了自己来这里的原因。 -

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Hmm... it is an easy and hard question at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
嗯...这问题说简单也简单，说难也难。

scripts.text: - You hear a voice complaining about something. -
scripts.translation: - 你听见有人在抱怨。 -

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Esseray! Such a son of a %@&$# spoiling my vacation...
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
艾瑟雷！那个该死的混蛋，竟然毁了我的假期...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Haaaaa~
My poor life~
Ahhh~ so many problems.
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
唉~我这苦命的人生~
啊~烦心事真多。

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Too ~ hard. Hey, little kid!
What's your name?
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
太~难受了。喂，小鬼！
你叫什么名字？

scripts.text: {0}, how about you?

[Nodor]
My name is Nodor! Nodor.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
我叫诺多尔！诺多尔。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey! I can see what you are thinking about in your face~
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
嘿！你心里想什么，全写在脸上了~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Since my name is Nodor I've been made fun of my whole life.
Condor and Odor...
Don't try to fool me.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
就因为我叫诺多尔，从小到大大家都拿我开玩笑。
什么“秃鹰”和“臭味”...
别想骗我。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Whatever the reason is... you are here!
Let's get together to go further.
Come again after a while~
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
不管你为什么来...反正你已经来了！
我们一起继续前进吧。
过一会儿再来找我~

scripts.text: - Talk to him again. -
scripts.translation: - 再和他聊聊。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Emmhmm ----- !!
- Nodor gives you a suspicious look. -
scripts.translation: - 诺多尔狐疑地看着你。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Didn't you know that the ^0000FFSuper Novice^000000 was excellent?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
你不知道^0000FF超级初心者^000000有多厉害吗？

scripts.text: - Nodor asks with confidence. -
scripts.translation: - 诺多尔自信地问道。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey! Super Novice~
Do you know who I am?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
喂，超级初心者~
你知道我是谁吗？

scripts.text: What are you talking about?!
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Heh...
You've got a lot of nerve, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
呵呵...
胆子不小嘛？

scripts.text: - This guy is a weirdo. -
scripts.translation: - 这家伙真古怪。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey! Super Novice ~
I will make you stronger!
So will you believe what I tell you?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
喂，超级初心者~
我能让你变强！
你愿意相信我说的话吗？

scripts.text: I won't follow you.
scripts.translation: 我才不听你的。

scripts.text: Why not? kehehe~
scripts.translation: 为什么不听？嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Refusing? Don't you want to be strong?
I'd love to do nothing too.
Just let me fish if you want to go.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
要拒绝我？你不想变强吗？
其实我也乐得什么都不做。
你想走的话，就让我继续钓鱼吧。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Emmhmm~ Do I sound harsh?
Hmm, I can't help using such words.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
嗯哼~我说话很凶吗？
没办法，我就是这副口气。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Don't sweat it.
It's no problem for me to teach you to be stronger.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
别担心，教你变强对我来说小菜一碟。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Great~!
What is your issue?
You don't know how to be stronger. Right?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
太好了~！
你遇到什么难题了？
是不知道怎么变强，对吧？

scripts.text: Yes, I can't get stronger.
scripts.translation: 是的，我没法变强。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hhhmmm ~!
There's a way to do it...
It is dangerous, but I can
tell you how.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
嗯~！
确实有办法...
虽然有危险，但我可以告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I'll only do this on one condition. You do not ask anything and you do everything I tell you!
How about it?
Are you willing to do this?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
我只有一个条件：别问问题，我说什么你就做什么！
怎么样？
你愿意吗？

scripts.text: No, I will not!
scripts.translation: 不，我才不干！

scripts.text: Let's do this!
scripts.translation: 好，就这么办！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
To be strong is the only way to live!
Do you want to be a weakling forever?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
只有变强才能活下去！
你想一辈子当弱者吗？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I will give you a tip.
You can't always be right.
Sometimes you need to check your ego and listen to others.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
给你个建议：
你不可能永远正确。
有时得放下自尊，听听别人的意见。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
All right --------- !!
Your passion will make you stronger.
You calm?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
很好——！！
你的热情会让你变得更强。
冷静下来了吗？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
What I want you to do is...
Hunt 1,000 monsters.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
我要你做的事就是...
猎杀1,000只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Do you know what this is for?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
知道我为什么要你这么做吗？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You know what a ^FF0000{0}^000000 monster is, right?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
你知道什么是^FF0000{0}^000000魔物吧？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hunt 1,000!
Do not say you can't do this!
I know that's a lot of monsters, but they're so weak!
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
猎杀1,000只！
别说你做不到！
我知道数量不少，不过它们弱得很！

scripts.text: Are you kidding me?
scripts.translation: 你在开玩笑吧？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Huh huh~!
Rembember, no questions!
Don't come back until you've hunted 1,000.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
呵呵~记住，不许问问题！
猎杀完1,000只再回来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, Nodor!

[Nodor]
Oh my god!
So frightened... let me see?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
天哪！
吓死我了...让我看看？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey! Super Novice!
Didn't I say to hunt 1,000?
Don't come back until you have.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
喂，超级初心者！
我不是叫你去猎杀1,000只吗？
没完成就别回来。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Have you hunted all 1,000 already?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
你已经猎杀完1,000只了吗？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You are better than I thought.
Anyway, what was the monster that I told you to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
你比我想象的能干嘛。
对了，我叫你猎杀什么魔物来着？

scripts.text: Poring
scripts.translation: 波利

scripts.text: Lunatic
scripts.translation: 疯兔

scripts.text: Fabre
scripts.translation: 绿棉虫

scripts.text: Picky
scripts.translation: 小鸡

scripts.text: Baphomet
scripts.translation: 巴风特

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Heheh? Can you seriously hunt Baphomet alone?
Don't tell a lie!! I will hit you!!
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
嘿嘿？你真能独自猎杀巴风特？
少骗人了！！小心我揍你！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Don't tell a lie!
I didn't tell you to hunt this!
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
别撒谎！
我叫你猎杀的不是这个！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
keheheheheheh~
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You annoyed me so I made you do this task...
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
你惹恼我了，所以我才故意给你这项任务...

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Wow! You actually hunted all 1,000?
I guess I can't question your passion to be stronger.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
哇！你居然真的猎杀完1,000只了？
看来你想变强的决心确实不容小觑。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Okay! So far so good.
I will let you know how to overcome your strength deficiencies.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
好！到目前为止都不错。
我来告诉你怎么弥补实力上的不足。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Oh! You already came here?
Didn't you say you have something to handle?
You have enough passion but...
you need to learn patience.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
哦！你这么快就回来了？
你不是说还有事情要处理吗？
热情是够了...
不过还得学会耐心。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hhhhhhhhhh~
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
呼~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Oh sorry! Sorry!
I got a letter from my brother a long time ago, will you read my letter for your information?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
啊，抱歉！抱歉！
我很久以前收到哥哥的一封信，你要不要读读看，了解一下情况？

scripts.text: Yes, I will
scripts.translation: 好，我读

scripts.text: No, I won't
scripts.translation: 不，我不读

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You should read more!
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
你该多读点书！

scripts.text: - He throws a bundled letter at you. -
scripts.translation: - 他把一封卷起来的信扔给你。 -

scripts.text:
Dear Bro. Nodor,
 
Hey Bro, it's your brother Nudor. How have you been? The reason I'm writing this letter is...
I need money for food. You've got so much money, so help me out.
scripts.translation:
亲爱的诺多尔哥哥：
 
哥哥你好，我是你弟弟努多尔。最近怎么样？我写信是想说...
我需要钱买吃的。你那么有钱，帮帮我吧。

scripts.text:
If you don't... Remember last time you %$&*@*&%$...
- The letter is crumpled, so you can't read more. -
I'm still in the Schwarzwald Republic.
~ Nudor
scripts.translation:
要是不帮我...还记得上次你%$&*@*&%$...
- 信被揉皱了，后面的内容看不清。 -
我还在修瓦尔茨巴尔德共和国。
~ 努多尔

scripts.text: - You get an uneasy feeling from reading this letter. -
scripts.translation: - 读完这封信，你感到一阵不安。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hu~u~
Hmm, I only have one brother and he's always asking for money.
It's got to be my fame... T_T
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
呼~
嗯，我就一个弟弟，他总是找我要钱。
一定是因为我太有名了... T_T

scripts.text: - Now you really have an uneasy feeling. -
scripts.translation: - 现在你真的感到不安了。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey- Super Novice {0}!
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
嘿，超级初心者{0}！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You can give some to my bro. He's up in the airship.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
你可以给我哥哥一些钱。他在飞空艇上。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Have you visited already?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
你已经去看过他了吗？

scripts.text: How much money should I give?
scripts.translation: 该给他多少钱？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Oh, you didn't go there yet?
Give him a little, ya~
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
哦，你还没去啊？
给他一点钱嘛~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
100,000 zeny is okay~
1,000,000 zeny is okay~
10,000,000 zeny is okay~
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
100,000 Zeny 就好~
1,000,000 Zeny 也好~
10,000,000 Zeny 也可以~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey, have you gone there?
I got another message from my bro.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
嘿，你去过了吗？
我又收到弟弟的消息了。

scripts.text:
Bro, someone gave me...
{0} Zeny.
You do care about me...
~ Nudor
scripts.translation:
哥哥，有人给了我...
{0} Zeny。
你果然还是关心我的...
~ 努多尔

scripts.text: He seemed so hungry...
scripts.translation: 他看起来好饿...

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
By the way...
{0} Zeny is so little considering my celebrity status, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
对了...
考虑到我的名气，{0} Zeny也太少了吧？你说呢？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Anyway~
{0} Zeny...
Don't you think you gave him too little? My reputation is gonna take a hit now.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
总之~
{0} Zeny...
你不觉得给得太少了吗？我的名声都要受影响了。

scripts.text: Hey...

[Nodor]
Wow, you've got my point already?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
哇，你已经明白我的意思了？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I think you are right.
This test is about your ability to open someone else's sympathy.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
我觉得你说得对。
这项考验考的是你能不能唤起别人的同情心。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I mean your consuming habit and your gut...
Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
我是说你的消费习惯和直觉...
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Hey, that's not my...
scripts.translation: 喂，我不是...

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hmm? Ah...
I almost forgot to tell
you how to exceed your limit,
didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
嗯？啊...
我差点忘了告诉你
怎么突破极限，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Eh-hem! I was not just killing time after I sent you!!
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
咳咳！我派你去可不是为了打发时间！！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
What the? --- ah? --- !!

[Nodor]
Watch out!! A bunch of Golems are running after us!
We... have to run...!!!
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
小心！！一群巨石怪追过来了！
我们...得快跑...！！！

scripts.text: What?!
scripts.translation: 什么？！

scripts.text: Um?
scripts.translation: 嗯？

scripts.text:
- You look around, and -
- there is nothing behind you. -
- When you are about to doubt... -
scripts.translation:
- 你环顾四周，-
- 身后却空无一物。 -
- 正当你心生怀疑时... -

scripts.text:
- You ask Nodor once -
- again in your fright... -
scripts.translation:
- 你惊慌地-
- 又问了诺多尔一次... -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You've still got some skill points that aren't used up.
I can't make you stronger until you use those points.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
你还有没用完的技能点。
用完这些点数之前，我没法让你变强。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Puhahahahahahahahahahah!!
Good! You scared yet?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
噗哈哈哈哈哈！！
很好！吓到了吧？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Sorry for scaring you!
I think our duty and mission as Novices is to make days joyful.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
抱歉吓到你了！
我觉得，初心者的职责和使命就是让每一天都充满欢乐。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Well then, don't you feel something just changed?
Feel your body lighter than before...?
Or more powerful?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
那么，你有没有感觉到变化？
身体是不是比以前轻盈了...？
或者更有力了？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Oh--- My--- (tut,tut,tut)!!
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
哦——天——（啧啧啧）！！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Mr. Sieu Ngu --
Not to be mean, but
you are a little dull...
Don't you feel different now?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
西乌·恩古先生——
我不是故意说你，不过你反应有点迟钝...
现在还没感觉到变化吗？

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？

scripts.text: I got it!
scripts.translation: 我明白了！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Eh--- right, you are dull, aren't you?
You already exceeded your limit.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
啊——对，你确实有点迟钝。
你已经突破极限了。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You can be stronger than before.
Wasn't it your dream?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
你现在比以前更强了。
这不就是你的梦想吗？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Ok~!
Now march to the world and live as a Novice and enjoy your free, happy life!
That's it!
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
好~！
去世界各地闯荡吧，继续做个初心者，享受自由快乐的生活！
就这样！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
(Pouting) ------------- !!
So you're finally back.

[Nodor]
To celebrate this new Novice comrade, I've prepared some equipment to give you --
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
为了庆祝又有一位初心者伙伴加入，我准备了一些装备送给你——

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Don't forget to make sure that you have enough ^FF0000inventory^000000 to take these items from me.
And don't say I didn't warn you either.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
记得确认^FF0000背包^000000里有足够空间，才能收下这些物品。
我可提醒过你了。

scripts.text: Yes, let me check my inventory.
scripts.translation: 好，我先检查一下背包。

scripts.text: I'm good, show me.
scripts.translation: 我准备好了，给我看看。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Well, well!
You know! Have no regrets.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
哎呀！
你看，拿了可别后悔哦。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
There are what I used to wear when I was younger,
but they are still good.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
这些是我年轻时穿戴过的装备，
不过现在依然很好用。

scripts.text: Second-hand stuff, huh?
scripts.translation: 二手货啊？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Give them back to me.
How can you react like that when I offer you my possessions?
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
还给我！
我把自己的东西送给你，你怎么能这样反应？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I...
I can't take back what I already gave away.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
我...
送出去的东西可不能收回来。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Now I am going to say greetings again.
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
现在，我要重新向你致意。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Let Super Novice {0} be blessed with the Super Novice Guardian!
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
愿超级初心者{0}获得超级初心者守护者的祝福！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Don't forget that you are a Novice.
Be a Novice always!
The aim of life is to have a nice and normal time!
scripts.translation:
[诺多尔]
别忘了你是初心者。
永远做个初心者吧！
人生的目标就是过得自在、平凡！

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Hush!
Please be quiet because you'll
scare all the fish away.
scripts.translation:
[钓鱼新手]
嘘！
请安静点，
会把鱼都吓跑的。

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Ahhh~ I have no money to buy any food.
I'm hungry, but I have no idea when Brother is coming...
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
啊~我没钱买吃的。
我饿死了，可不知道哥哥什么时候才回来...

scripts.text: Hey, are you... Mr. Nudor?
scripts.translation: 喂，你是...努多尔先生吗？

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Eeeeeh?! Who wants to know?
Do I know you?
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
咦？！你打听这个干吗？
我认识你吗？

scripts.text: - You explain to Nudor why you have come to see him. -
scripts.translation: - 你向努多尔说明了来找他的原因。 -

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Aha! You've come to give me some pocket money in place of my bro~
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
啊哈！你是替我哥哥来给我零花钱的吧~

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Wowowow~~ How much did he give you?
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
哇哇哇~~他给了你多少？

scripts.text:
- Nudor stares with twinkling -
- eyes, holding out his hands. -
- How much do you want to give? -
scripts.translation:
- 努多尔眼睛闪闪发亮，-
- 伸出双手等着。 -
- 你想给他多少？ -

scripts.text: I have no money
scripts.translation: 我没钱

scripts.text: Give 100,000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 给100,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Give 300,000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 给300,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Give 1,000,000 Zeny
Give all the money you have
scripts.translation: 把身上的钱全给你

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
- crying -
I hate Nodor --- !
I hate you too --- !
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
- 哭着说 -
我讨厌诺多尔——！
我也讨厌你——！

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Lovely~~ Did he give you {0} Zeny? That's pretty much!
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
太棒了~~他给了你{0} Zeny？真大方！

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Oh... oh my gosh, are you really giving me all the Zeny you have? Really?
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
哦...天哪，你真的要把身上所有的Zeny都给我？真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
What? But where is {0} Zeny?
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
什么？那{0} Zeny呢？

scripts.text: No, not really...
scripts.translation: 不，还是算了...

scripts.text: Give it all
scripts.translation: 全给你

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Pshaw! How disappointing!
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
嘁！真让人失望！

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Eh? But you don't have any money. You're so poor, huh?
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
咦？可你身上一分钱都没有。你这么穷啊？

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Woa~!! {0} Zeny! This helped me so much~ Tehee~
I can't believe it...
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
哇~！！{0} Zeny！这可帮大忙了~嘿嘿~
真不敢相信...

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Did you know? You're really handsome~
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
你知道吗？你真的好帅~

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
I need to tell you, you are really... really~ beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
我得告诉你，你真的...真的~好漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
- You feel like you're being -
- tricked, so go back to Nodor. -
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
- 你觉得自己好像被耍了，-
- 于是回去找诺多尔。 -

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
I cannot believe that my bro sent me money... I love it~
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
真不敢相信哥哥真的给我寄钱了...我太喜欢了~

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Ooooops!
{0}, hush --- !!

[Nudor]
Don't tell Nodor about this~~
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
别告诉诺多尔这件事哦~~

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Ahhh~ I have no money to buy any food.
I'm hungry, but I have no idea when Brother is coming...
scripts.translation:
[努多尔]
啊~我没钱买吃的。
我饿死了，可不知道哥哥什么时候才回来...
